facts.fact: University World News says the Ethiopian Media Authority this year introduced the use of an AI system to try to eradicate misinformation and hate speech.
University World News says the National Election Board of Ethiopia began to use AI tools in planning and conducting the election and in voter and candidate registration.

University World News names AI in use at both the Ethiopian Media Authority (misinformation monitoring) and the National Election Board (election planning and registration), two bodies in different sectors.
facts.system: Media Authority AI system; Election Board AI tools
